name: Mapo Tofu
steps: Cube tofu and finely chop mushrooms, garlic and ginger. Mix starch with water into a smooth slurry.
Fry mushrooms in oil for 6 minutes until dry. Add garlic, ginger and doubanjiang; cook gently for 1 minute.
Add stock, soy sauce and tofu; simmer gently for 6 minutes, shaking the pan to avoid breaking tofu.
Stir in slurry and simmer 2 minutes until glossy. Finish with crushed Sichuan pepper and chopped spring onions.
tips: Choose vegetarian doubanjiang and taste before adding extra salt.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
